summary: Property acquisition under Section 352 of Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act, 1980 invalid; no statutory power of compulsory acquisition exists; Article 300A requires seven procedural safeguards: notice, hearing, reasoned decision, public purpose, fair compensation, timely execution, conclusive outcome; concurrent High Court findings upheld; appeal dismissed; Corporation directed to initiate proper acquisition proceedings under Section 536/537 or restore ownership within five months.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Kerala v. T.M. Peter (1980) 3 SCC 554
Nagpur Improvement Trust v. Vithal Rao
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; Corporation to initiate valid acquisition proceedings or restore ownership records within five months.
